scope: Published 0.2.205 public CRX acceptance pin and baseline/workflow guard; no hosted or installed-extension acceptance in this lane
changes: scripts/published-store-crx-target.mjs owns the pinned version, item ID and independently observed public CRX digest; it rejects workflow token, approved baseline version or item ID drift.

scripts/hosted-guest-acceptance.mjs checks the selected target before hosted credentials or browser setup, then retains the original CRX hash, CRX3 signing-key/ID, ZIP safety, manifest version, adapted-tree and receipt checks.
.github/workflows/hosted-guest-acceptance.yml passes 0.2.205 in preflight and acceptance and names the current public CRX.
.github/workflows/ci.yml runs the focused causal guard automatically.

verification.redBeforeFix: Stale approved-baseline test failed with Missing expected rejection when the provisional target reader ignored baseline contents.
verification.greenAfterFix: 4/4 focused node tests passed, including real hosted-script preflight refusal for 0.2.130; node syntax checks and Biome checks passed for touched JavaScript.
verification.scratchOnlyConstantReturnMutation: Three target tests failed against a scratch-only implementation that always returned the pinned target; repository source was not mutated.
verification.notRun: No heavy build, release, native browser, hosted workflow dispatch or Google Store installed-extension test.

remainingBoundary: The existing guest harness defaults to Chromium --headless=new and prepares a published_store_crx_unpacked receipt by adding the verified public key and removing Store verification metadata from a temporary copy. A future successful run would verify that adapted public payload in its owned harness, not Chrome's Store-installed lifecycle or preservation of a returning guest's installed profile state.
